releases.notes:
## AntiRat 2.0.1

This release closes the reported basic session-token capture path and removes several sources of severe runtime overhead.

### Security and containment

- Instruments Mixin handlers after they are copied into Minecraft `User`/`Session` classes, spoofing credential constructor arguments before the first handler instruction can read them.
- Expands startup detection for basic networked constructor-token Mixins and attributes merged handler names back to their source mod.
- Adds a Windows locked-JAR fallback: AntiRat suppresses entrypoints, locks guarded capabilities, creates a SHA-256-verified quarantine copy, and removes the original through a minimal helper after Minecraft exits.
- Makes `allow.sha256` a real reviewed-binary override for ordinary runtime capabilities while keeping session-token permission separate and fixed exfiltration endpoints blocked.

### Compatibility and performance

- Stops recalculating an entire mod JAR hash every frame when a mod repeatedly calls a credential API. A successful hash verification is cached briefly, while file metadata changes force immediate revalidation.
- Uses fast caller attribution for hot Unsafe paths and skips unnecessary stack walks for normal Mojang/Microsoft endpoints.
- Bounds runtime event and report-suppression caches to prevent unbounded memory growth.
- Retested the installed C2ME build: score 48 / Medium, automatic quarantine false.

### Verification

- All seven targets compiled and passed their complete unit/adversarial suites.
- All seven Minecraft clients launched through Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and passed 42/42 live assertions each (294/294 total), including the constructor-token barrier and animated popup render.
- Every release JAR passed checksum, exact Minecraft/Java metadata, agent manifest, token-carrier guard, deferred-quarantine helper, UI, and icon audits.

Download the one JAR matching your exact Minecraft version. `SHA256SUMS` is included for verification.

releases.notes:
## AntiRat 2.0.0

One client-side Fabric JAR per supported Minecraft version:

- Minecraft 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.8, and 1.21.11 (Java 21)
- Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.2, and 26.2 (Java 25)

### In-game UI updates

- `/antirat placeholder` now opens its transient UI preview directly without publishing a fake security event or adding a chat notification with a reopen command.
- Ports the complete animated AntiRat threat-details panel to every supported GUI API.
- Responsively scales the whole established layout at automatic and high GUI scales so the panel and its lower evidence section remain on-screen.
- Samples and displays the complete bundled 256 x 256 AntiRat logo instead of a cropped texture quadrant.
- Preserves the slide animation, risk styling, event details, summary, tip, evidence, and Escape close behavior.
- Loads and registers the logo directly, without requiring Fabric API.

### Verification

- All seven targets completed fresh compile, unit-test, and release-build runs.
- All seven targets launched through Fabric Loader 0.19.3 using the required Java runtime.
- 287/287 live runtime assertions passed across the seven versions.
- 7/7 logs passed explicit gates rejecting placeholder event publication and client/render errors.
- 7/7 release artifacts passed checksum, exact Minecraft metadata, Java bytecode, agent manifest, icon, responsive-layout, animated-popup, and silent-preview bytecode audits.

Download the JAR whose filename exactly matches the Minecraft version. `SHA256SUMS` is included for integrity verification.
